question: Do NMP, futility, LMR and MVV-LVA execute at all in a tuning-shaped configuration, and what does each one contribute to the node count at fixed depth?
tuning: No weight or margin tuning used these positions. The arms and the margin sweep were fixed before measurement.
genome: The adopted default genome (material 100, advantage 23.967050360966205, attack 25.714516982666414, defence 32.5643023919054), i.e. exactly what the evolution harness produces and the frozen protocol scored.

acceptance.firing: nmp_attempts, futility_eligible and lmr_reduced all nonzero in at least one documented arm
acceptance.attribution: Each technique's node count compared against the same-window reference arm on identical positions
acceptance.adoption: Node reduction alone is never acceptance; defaults stay off unless paired play is at least equal
acceptance.insufficient_evidence: Keep every technique disabled by default

attribution: Each arm is compared with the arm it differs from by one switch: PVS against plain alpha-beta, every selective technique against PVS, and MVV-LVA additionally against a variable-material control where capture values are not all equal.
improvements: Run this same script at 8d22a11 and at the branch head to attribute the search changes; arms the older revision cannot express record "unavailable" instead of failing.
